from brain.alphas import alpha
import numpy as np
import numpy.typing as npt

def _pasteurize(a, universe):
    a = a.copy()
    a[~universe.astype(bool)] = np.nan
    return a

@alpha(data=["close", "high", "low", "volume"], store=[])
def alpha_smooth2_range_sqrt_invvol025_doc_example(data, store) -> npt.NDArray[np.float32]:
    if data.close.shape[0] < 3:
        return np.full(data.close.shape[1], np.nan, dtype=np.float32)
    spread = data.high - data.low
    spread = np.where(spread == 0, np.nan, spread)
    hl_diff = ((data.close - data.low) - (data.high - data.close)) / spread
    delta_hl = hl_diff[1:, :] - hl_diff[:-1, :]
    base = -np.nanmean(delta_hl[-2:, :], axis=0)
    range_pct = np.where(data.close[-1] == 0, np.nan, spread[-1] / data.close[-1])
    vol = np.where(data.volume[-1] <= 0, np.nan, data.volume[-1])
    a = base * np.sqrt(np.maximum(range_pct, 0)) / np.power(vol, 0.25)
    a = _pasteurize(a, data.close[-1])
    return a.astype(np.float32)
